page.overview:
Who is Suhbekhar Dynasty?

The Suhbekhar Dynasty is a powerful dynasty of the Necrons whose worlds are located within the Jericho Reach and who may be related to the phenomenon known as the Dark Pattern.

The region known to Humanity as the Jericho Reach was once, numberless aeons ago, but a portion of the holdings of a great house of the Necrons called the Suhbekhar Dynasty. The last phaeron of the dynasty -- Ahmontekh, called the "Crimson Scythe" -- was a general of great repute.

It was Ahmontekh who, according to the Lamentations of Yr, defeated the proud Nuada, beloved of the Old Ones, and who plunged his mighty war-scythe into the hallowed ground of Xoth.

As the War in Heaven neared its climax, it was Ahmontekh who breached the Walls of Ib and who was first to pass through the Dolmen Gate on the brink of the Ebon Void.
